text:
eng-oncall-bot: Heads-up — rolling TLS cert swap targeting control-plane (us-west2) originally planned for 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC is being rescheduled to 2026-03-18 00:00 UTC (approx +2h). Reason: a high-risk customer migration pushed into our original slot. Expected impact: brief reconnects (<=10s) for long-lived streams/ws; all REST API requests will continue to succeed. Posting status page + customer draft below. Please ack if you see any blockers.

jordan_sre: Ack. For clarity — Dedicated customers with pinned control-plane endpoints, any manual action required on their side?

lina_ops: Short answer: no manual action expected. Dedicated control-plane proxies will rotate their certs from the old key to the new via a canary-first rollout. If a pinned client verifies cert fingerprint it may need reconfiguration (rare). Routing fallback will absorb transient ws reconnects. We'll enable shorter health-check backoffs during the window to avoid long circuit-open states.

maria_custsuc: Can you drop the customer email copy here? I'll queue it for sending after final check. Also want a one-liner for account-level notices for customers with long-lived connections.

alex_platform: Draft status page update (please review):
```
Summary: We performed a scheduled TLS certificate rotation for the control-plane in us-west2.
Impact: Some customers with long-lived WebSocket or streaming connections may have experienced short reconnects (~<10s). REST/API traffic remained available.
Timeline: 00:00 UTC — Rotation started
00:09 UTC — Rotation completed
Current status: Monitoring, no ongoing impact.
```
Suggest adding: "No action required — if you see repeated reconnects reach out to support."

maria_custsuc: Customer email draft below. Keep it short:
```
Subject: Brief maintenance completed — TLS cert rotation (us-west2)
Hi —
We performed a brief TLS certificate rotation for our control-plane in us-west2. If your application uses long-lived WebSocket or streaming connections you may have seen a short reconnect. No action required in most cases. If you have pinned cert fingerprints, please update to the new cert printed in the portal.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```
Please confirm the exact fingerprint link before send.

deploy-bot: Rollout log snippet:
```
[00:00:02] starting rollout on group=us-west2-cp-canary
[00:02:17] cert applied to node=cp-canary-3
[00:05:48] canary health checks pass (10/10)
[00:06:10] starting batch=1 nodes=5 target=cp-pool-a
[00:08:55] batch=1 health ok
[00:09:01] completing rollout, switching live symlinks
```

jordan_sre: Nice. Post-rotation checks I ran:
```
# curl health endpoints
for n in cp-1 cp-2 cp-3 cp-4 cp-5; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s - $n\n" https://$n.internal.redwood-inference/health; done
# verify TLS cert fingerprint
openssl s_client -connect cp-pool-a.internal.redwood-inference:443 -servername cp-pool-a.internal.redwood-inference 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```
All nodes returned 200 and fingerprint matches the new cert.

lina_ops: Confirmed — monitoring shows no uptick in 5xxs or customer error rates. Latency unchanged. I've disabled the aggressive backoff and restored normal health-check cadence.

maria_custsuc: I've queued the email, will send in 10m after we flip the status page to "Completed". I also prepared an account-targeted blurb for customers who reported long-lived connections last quarter.

eng-oncall-bot: Update — Rollout completed at 00:09 UTC. No customer incidents opened. Status page updated to "Completed". Sending customer notification now. :white_check_mark:

alex_platform: Quick internal note for postmortem tooling: tag this operation as `cert-rotation/us-west2/2026-03-18` so cost and op-time can be correlated.

deploy-bot: Automation summary: 6 nodes rotated, 1 canary iteration, zero rollback events.

jordan_sre: Handing off to daytime oncall for any follow-ups. I'll be monitoring logs for the next 30m then drop off.

lina_ops: Thanks — I'll own any emergent customer tickets. If anything pops, ping @oncall-day.

eng-oncall-bot: Closing thread. If you need the fingerprint or status page copy exported as a template, ask here and I'll attach it.
